name: lask-highlight
description: Renders Lask sources and captured terminal sessions to SVG cards for the README.

scripts.render: npm run render:code && npm run render:session
scripts.capture: cd ../../doc/assets && { echo '$ lask check'; lask check; echo; echo '$ lask run cowsay-hello Lask'; lask run cowsay-hello Lask; } 2>&1 | grep -v 'WARNING: The requested image' > session.txt
